exposure: Meperidine subgroups based on administration times (<1 h, 1‒4 h, ≥4 h)
cohort: 138 pregnant women undergoing labor pain management
finding: The study found that regional analgesia methods (epidural, CSE) provided better pain control and maternal satisfaction compared to meperidine, with no significant difference in delivery outcomes or neonatal APGAR scores.
mod_finding: CSE analgesia showed a trend towards a lower cesarean section rate compared to other methods.
